plotSections.title: Farewells from the Deities
bullets: Ben departs by opening a doorway into his traveling tavern, reminding the party they are always welcome there and hinting that he will see some members sooner than others.
Mahali leaves with Ben, mentioning that if the party returns to the stronghold he plans to prepare a celebratory meal.
Narul silently bids the party farewell with a respectful nod and bow before departing.

Emhet offers the party one final chance to ask for assistance before leaving, reminds them that they now hold the keys, and warns: 'If the mind walks, hold your breath. Do not yell. Trust the path, gatekeeper.'

plotSections.title: The Raven Queen's Counsel
bullets: The Raven Queen approaches after the other deities depart, her appearance gradually shifting from a harpy-like form into a regal humanoid figure wearing a porcelain mask and flowing black robes.
She acknowledges that the party has formed opinions of her but says she understands mortals because she was once mortal herself.
She reveals she has walked the mortal world and has seen some members of the party upon the Everfalls, lingering particularly on Sylan and Dana.

She admits the party has exceeded her expectations, specifically expressing confidence in Sylan's resolve while noting that Walker and Ord have begun to show her more than she expected from ordinary mortals.
She agrees to guide the party where they need to go but warns them not to waste either her time or their own through foolish choices.
She emphasizes that death should not be treated carelessly, that every life has only so many chances, and encourages the party to make their lives meaningful rather than preparing for death.
When offering Sylan one final request, she accepts his decision not to ask anything further and instead reminds him to remember where he has been, value the life he has, and not live expecting death.
The Raven Queen reminds Sylan that he has been given a weapon and is 'a talon of my order, not a butcher,' emphasizing precision and purpose over indiscriminate killing.
After departing, her humanoid appearance transforms back into a shadowy harpy-like figure with large black wings as she flies away.

plotSections.title: Testing the Newly Acquired Keys
bullets: After the deities depart, the remaining allies include Glimmen, Juten Prime, Elrus, Araden, Boris, and Kit Anger.
The party begins experimenting with the newly acquired door-opening ability or keys.
Gerk repeatedly opens a doorway, finding that it initially leads to different random locations, including a rainy mountainside and later a quiet nighttime forest.
Dana suggests Gerk focus on a familiar destination such as the stronghold while opening the doorway.
Even after concentrating on the stronghold and making a Wisdom check, the doorway still opens to a different location, suggesting Gerk has not yet mastered control of the ability.
